Carney's European Pivot Focuses on French Islands

Mark Carney, former Governor of the Bank of England and Bank of Canada, is reportedly making a pivot towards Europe. This shift is highlighted by his engagement with French islands off the coast of Newfoundland. One commentary suggests this move signifies an end to the 'American age' and a new era of European influence.
